breakfast.en: Chinese Yam & Millet Porridge + Steamed Egg with Matsutake + Hong Kong Sweet Potato + Banana

lunch.zh: 白米混少量16谷饭 ＋ 薄切牛肉片 / 牛肉粒 ＋ 白灼 / 清炒芦笋 ＋ 莲藕鸡汤芹菜松茸
lunch.en: White Rice mixed with 16-Grain Rice + Thinly Sliced Beef / Diced Beef + Blanched / Stir-fried Asparagus + Lotus Root Chicken Soup with Celery & Matsutake

dinner.zh: 16谷米饭 / 16谷粗粮饭 ＋ 葱香鸡腿肉 ＋ 温拌莴笋丝 / 莴笋片 ＋ 同午餐汤品（午餐煲制，晚餐复用）
dinner.en: 16-Grain Rice + Scallion Chicken Thigh + Warm Tossed Shredded/Sliced Celtuce + Same as Lunch Soup (Reused for Dinner)

notes.zh: 午餐汤品晚餐复用，温拌菜必须温热
notes.en: Lunch soup reused for dinner, Warm tossed dishes must be served warm
